title: Chapter 768 Orb; Search!
content:
Chapter 768 Orb; Search!

Chapter 768 Orb; Search!

Not bad?

Not bad?

The power of destruction, the Saint King Crystal, the Great Dao fragment…Which item wasn't a supreme treasure?

If it was someone else, they would definitely be overjoyed.

Lin Fan took another look at the golden pearl that had been fused with the World-Destroying Golden Lotus within his body before entering a state of cultivation.

He wanted to make a breakthrough as quickly as possible, so that he could completely escape the danger that Subhuti might face.

However, hard work didn't always lead to results.

Especially when his cultivation reached a certain peak.

This situation was the most obvious.

In the blink of an eye, 50 years had passed.

In these 50 years, Lin Fan's cultivation state had indeed improved.

However, there were no signs of a breakthrough.

Lin Fan could not help but feel a little helpless.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan's mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you have possessed the Advanced System for 500 years. You have obtained the Green Lotus Pearl x1, the Great Dao Fragment x5, the Saint King Spiritual Crystal x10, and the Saint King Cultivation Technique Upgrade Gem x1.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he could not help but feel a little disappointed.

It had been 500 years?

After such a long time, he still hadn't become the strongest. In fact, he hadn't even reached the highest level. What a failure!

The strongest?

The highest level?

Too much of a failure?

If a Holy Lord heard this, who knew what kind of expression he would have.

500 years?

Wasn't that just time for a nap?

Just this…He still wanted to become the strongest?

Right now, Lin Fan could be said to be the number one Holy Master.

In the end, he still failed?

How could the other Holy Masters live?

After a while, Lin Fan finally shifted his attention to the Green Lotus Pearl.

[Green Lotus Pearl: A mysterious pearl that comes from the same vein as the Golden Lotus Pearl that the host has. After gathering seven pearls, you will obtain incomparably powerful and mysterious power, as well as unexpected changes.]

7 orbs?

Why did it look like a dragon pearl?

Now that he had two of them, could he summon a divine dragon with seven of them?

Lin Fan could not help but ponder.

Now that he did not have a good way to increase his cultivation, perhaps he could try to collect it?

Thinking of this, Lin Fan said," System, can I find out where the remaining 5 orbs are?"

[After spending 100 billion spirit stones, the location of the pearl can be detected within 5,000 kilometers. Do you want to use it?]

100 billion Spiritual Stones?

This was even more than the total amount of Spirit Stones that Lin Fan had used up so far.

However, the more this was the case, the more it showed how extraordinary the orb was.

Hence, Lin Fan hesitated for a moment before replying,"Yes!"

"Whoosh!"

Instantly, the spirit stones hidden in the inner space, which formed countless mountains, turned into streams of light and disappeared without a trace.

At the same time, Lin Fan's mind seemed to have gained some sort of enlightenment.

Among them, there were two spots of light that flickered slightly around his body.

This was obviously the pearl.

As for the other pearls, they were clearly not within the range of ten thousand miles.

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to Li Ke and used soul communication with him.

....

Fire God Palace.

A golden mark that looked like a volcano appeared on Li Ke's forehead.

His entire body was filled with a tyrannical aura.

"Li Ke!"

Li Ke, who was sitting in the main seat and meditating, suddenly changed his expression.

He hurriedly knelt on the ground and said,"Master!"

Even though Li Ke was already the Fire God Palace's Palace Master and his cultivation had been forcefully raised to the Imperial level.

Even though he had immense power now.

However, he still had the highest respect for Lin Fan.

" I'm looking for these 5 orbs. Keep an eye out." Lin Fan said.

As soon as he finished speaking, he sent over the forms and characteristics of the five pearls.

At the same time, he also taught Li Ke a way to contact Lin Fan.

This was the reverse communication method that Lin Fan had obtained from the system a hundred years ago.

"Yes, sir!" Li Ke said excitedly.

Excited?

That's right!

Excitement!

To Li Ke, it was an honor to be able to work for Lin Fan!

It was a great honor!

Furthermore, Lin Fan had even taught him the way to contact him!

This was too delightful!

Then, Lin Fan communicated with Ma Zheng's soul and repeated the same words.

"Thump! Thump!"

At this moment, there was a dull knock on the door.

Lin Fan looked up. It was Little Rock standing outside the door. His expression was a little nervous.

Lin Fan wasn't too bothered by this.

He waved his hand and the door opened.

"Yes, Master!" Little Rock bent his back and slowly walked in.

"What is it?" Lin Fan asked.

"Master... Master, many of the geniuses on Earth have reached the planetary state and have the ability to cross the void. If they were to stay on Earth, it might be a waste of their talents. "Therefore, I was thinking, why don't we let them go out and make a living? At the same time, we can spread the reputation of our Coiling Dragon Villa?"

When Little Rock said this, he stuttered from time to time.

Obviously, he was really nervous.

When Lin Fan heard that, he hesitated for a moment before saying," Alright, you can leave."

"Also, ask them to help me find the five Orbs after we get out."

After saying that, Lin Fan sent the characteristics and shapes of the five orbs into Little Rock's mind.

When Little Rock heard this, he was so happy that he almost jumped up.

Agreed, Master agreed!

He took a few deep breaths before recovering.

After leaving the room, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann quickly surrounded him.

"Big brother, what did master say?"

"Big brother, did master agree?"

"Big brother…"

Even though Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann had been calling Little Rock 'big brother'.

However, every time Little Rock heard the word 'big brother', he could not help but smile.

"Don't worry, we'll talk as we walk." Little Rock cleared his throat.

Then, he walked forward, followed by Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann.

However, after walking for a while, Little Rock still did not speak.

This made the three of them extremely anxious.

"Master has already agreed," Little Rock looked at them and the corners of his mouth curled up again.

Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann jumped up.

"Really?"

"That's great!"

"Haha!"

"Not only did he agree, Master even gave us a mission to find the Orb!" said Little Rock.

"Can we work for Master now?"

"Good!"

"That's great!"

The three of them were excited again.

They had the same thoughts as Li Ke. To be able to work for Lin Fan was an honor!

Then, the four of them set off together and quickly gathered all the geniuses on Earth.

Then, he flew into the void.

Lin Fan had taken in the conversation between the little rocks and their reactions.

Lin Fan just smiled and didn't care too much about it.
